label: Ititu
note: Built up in layers, not left in one batch.

about.text: A concentrated sour milk curd of the Borana of southern Ethiopia, built up in a smoked vessel over weeks by adding fresh milk and draining whey.

links.name: Karssa et al. 2024, Insights on the microbiology of Ethiopian fermented milk products

facts.v: Mainly camel; cow, goat or sheep also used
